newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Chrysler "favors" Brazil for plant with BMW.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler "favors" Brazil for plant with BMW.

text.p: Chrysler Corp President Robert J. Eaton said Thursday that he favored Brazil as a site for a motor plant Chrysler plans to build with Germany's Bayerische Motoren-Werke AG.

"We are favoring Brazil. We are looking at many locations. (The Brazilian state of) Parana is being considered, but others are too," Eaton told reporters at a ceremony to announce Chrysler's new $315 million Dakota pick-up plant.
Eaton said the production site for Chrysler's joint venture with BMW should be announced within about 60 days. He said Argentina was also a strong candidate for the motor plant's location.
The Dakota plant, which will be built in Curitiba, in the southern state of Parana, is expected to be producing 12,000 units a year by 1998, and will have a capacity of 40,000 units in two shifts.
